image.foundLinks: Earlier publications found (one link per line)
image.aiNotConfigured: AI clue not configured on the analysis service.
image.aiScore: Model score: {{percent}}%. Experimental clue: never a conclusion.

limits.reception: The SHA-256 fingerprint proves the file has not changed since it was received; it says nothing about its authenticity.
limits.already_seen: Only finds images already stored in MASO; heavy cropping can prevent a match.
limits.metadata: Metadata is easily removed or edited: neither its presence nor its absence proves anything on its own.
limits.provenance: Very few images carry Content Credentials; their absence is normal.
limits.recompression: ELA is a clue to interpret: sharp edges, text and repeated recompression also create differences.
limits.reverse_search: No engine knows every image: no result does not prove the image is recent.
limits.ai_clue: Generated-image detectors have limited and variable reliability: never conclude on this clue alone.
limits.video: Technical information describes the received file, often recompressed by the platform.
limits.keyframes: Keyframes are used for reverse search: a video from another country or year is often found this way.
limits.https: HTTPS protects the connection; a malicious site can use it too.
limits.domain: A recent domain is not necessarily misleading, but opportunistic sites are often created shortly before a crisis.
limits.hosting: The host shows where the server is, not who publishes.
limits.directory: The score only assesses the source, never the truth of a claim.
limits.existing: Only finds fact-checks published online or stored in MASO.
limits.archive: The archive keeps the page as it was: useful if it is edited or deleted.

source.title: Source profile
source.fromLinkHint: Assess the site's reliability, criterion by criterion.
source.name: Name
source.criteriaHint: Each criterion is filled in by a team member, with a justification.

criteriaHelp.identity: Is the publisher, address or legal notice identifiable?
criteriaHelp.transparency: Are sources, method and funding disclosed?
criteriaHelp.seniority: How long has the source existed?
criteriaHelp.corrections_history: Has it spread debunked content before? Does it correct its errors?
criteriaHelp.proximity: Does it have direct access to the facts?
criteriaHelp.corroboration: Is its information confirmed by other sources?

source.missingJustification: Every assessed criterion must be justified.
source.scoreHint: Average of the assessed criteria. The score only assesses the source, never the truth of a claim.
source.confidentialHint: Contact details or identity to protect. Every access is recorded in the audit log.
source.confidentialLogged: Access recorded in the audit log.

verdictDefinition.confirmed: The claim is accurate and supported by evidence.
verdictDefinition.misleading: Contains accurate elements but gives a false impression.
verdictDefinition.out_of_context: Authentic content presented with a date, place or meaning that is not its own.
verdictDefinition.false: The claim is contradicted by the evidence.
verdictDefinition.fabricated: Content created or altered to deceive, including with generative AI.
verdictDefinition.unverifiable: The available elements do not allow a conclusion to date.

onboarding.s1Text: Image, video, link or text received on Facebook or WhatsApp: MASO analyses it and gives you clues, never an automatic verdict.
onboarding.s2Text: Evidence, sources, experts and official figures gathered in one case. The fact-checker proposes, the editor-in-chief validates and publishes.
onboarding.s3Text: Install the app: your cases, the directory and statistics stay available without network.
